title: Core plugin registry and graph extension API
description: Add isolated plugin, element type, relation type, validator, and generic extension graph registries without embedding lifecycle vocabulary in Core.
completion_criteria: Add createArchMap()/use() with instance-isolated plugin registries while preserving the current top-level default API.
Add registerElementType, registerRelationType, and registerValidator; adapt registerView to the instance registry.
Add inert generic extension element/relation storage and plugin dependency/conflict checks.
Leave additive registry paths for policies, serializers, importers, exporters, overlays, and themes.
success_criteria: All v0.3 tests and samples pass unchanged.
Two instances can install different plugins without state leakage.
Core has no import dependency on lifecycle code.
